issue.title: Edge worker UI types are out of date with the worker API spec
issue.body:
The generated TypeScript types under the edge3 provider's UI (`openapi-gen`) lag `v2-edge-generated.yaml`: they have no `version_data`, `ExecuteCallback` or `TestConnection`. The `ts-compile-lint-edge-ui` hook only regenerates them for files under `/openapi/`, and `pnpm codegen` fails with `@7nohe/openapi-react-query-codegen` 2.2.0 (`-c axios` is rejected). Fix the codegen command and regenerate.

---

Drafted with Claude Code (Opus 5.5).
